status: DRAFT for Koala's approval: built from the efood prices on 11 Nov 2026, same rules as Overoll (packages/core). Koala confirms the catalog, the in-store prices and the welcome gift before launch.
notes: Point costs are not written here: scripts/generate-seed.ts computes them with packages/core rewardBaseCost().

shelf_price_cents comes from data/koala/menu.json (efood prices). A 'choose any' reward is priced at the most expensive item it covers; the coffee + pie combo at the dearest coffee plus the dearest pie.
The cinnamon roll is listed on efood only for Αργυρούπολη today: Koala confirms both stores have it, since it is the welcome gift.
